description: This file implements the core logic for the 'git fetch' command within the Git source codebase. It handles fetching references from remote repositories, updating local refs, managing packed data, pruning stale references, and orchestrating fetch transactions and parallel fetches. It includes functions for preparing transports, processing refspecs, handling fetch head updates, and setting upstream branches, which are all central to Git's fetch operation.
